card.name: "Any" before unused portion to discard
card.fires_on: The word "any" (or "Any") right before "unused portion/solution" or "remainder" in single-use vial instructions, usually after discard, dispose of, or do not save.

modes.label: After discard verb
modes.description: "any" follows a verb like discard or dispose of, ahead of unused solution.
modes.example: Discard<< any>> unused solution. • Do not mix with

modes.label: Sentence start
modes.description: "Any" opens a sentence about the unused portion of a single-use vial.
modes.example: To administer a 20 mg dose, draw up 1.0 mL of the reconstituted solution.<< Any>> unused portion should be discarded.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning leftover or remaining, such as remaining and leftover.
card.plain: It fires on "any" when the label is about to say that leftover drug in a single-use vial should be thrown away.
